reasons.reason: Two explicit MINIMUM requirements are not documented in the authorities: recent experience with state grant administration, and knowledge of the state financial-management regulations and grant law. The letter names this once, after the evidence, together with the supported ramp-up signal from BAR. No text repair remains.
reasons.recommended_action: At approval, accept that the application goes forward with this known gap. No edit is needed.

reasons.reason: The employer requires the Jobbnorge fields for education and work experience to be completed, a diploma uploaded from Vitnemålsportalen, and references (attester) confirming position size. The deadline is 25.09.2026, one day away.
reasons.recommended_action: Fill in the fields and upload the documents manually when submitting. None of this belongs in the package.

reasons.reason: The vacancy is written in Nynorsk. The package is in Bokmål by design and makes no claim about Nynorsk writing ability.
reasons.recommended_action: None, unless the candidate wants to address it in an interview.

known_limitations: Not documented: recent state grant administration (R02), knowledge of state financial-management regulations and grant law (R04), or grant case handling, recipient accounts control and recipient follow-up (R17).
Not documented: reporting to or dialogue with a ministry or other superior body (R13), and experience with voluntary organisations or Bufdir's target groups (R14).

Collaboration is documented only internally at OUS: a stakeholder process of about 50 people, workshops, and Power BI training beyond his own department. External collaboration is not documented, and whether the training went outside OUS is unresolved.
The allocation model was completed and handed over to controllers in early 2026. Its organisational use and realised benefits are unresolved. The text claims neither.
The views on how AI could be used in grant work are the candidate's forward-looking proposal. They are not delivered work and not knowledge of Bufdir's systems.
material_strategy_change: The strategy deprioritised AI as novelty value, but R07 is a MINIMUM requirement that explicitly asks for thoughts on how AI could change grant work. The final gives AI its own letter paragraph: the registered superuser role, the human-governed workflow, and a bounded proposal that leaves the assessment of each applicant with the case handler. The budget-tool case now carries R20: he recommended a broader restructuring, the implementation lead chose a narrow refactor, and he delivered it under control. The benefits framework (PRJ-04) moved to the CV only. The letter adds one explicit gap sentence placed after the evidence.
upstream_claim_repaired: Understatement repaired: the strategy classed R07 as ADJACENT and steered away from AI, which would have left a minimum requirement thinly answered even though the superuser role and the human-governed AI workflow are documented. Internal labels (STE, REGERP, DRG) were translated or dropped for a Bufdir reader. No inflated upstream claim was found.
notes: The SUPPORTED minimum requirements R01, R05, R06, R08 and R10, and the important requirement R20, are all answered in the CV and letter pair.
The platform's JobMatch percentage and its AI-generated skills list were treated as platform content, not as employer requirements.
